name: XC6206P332MR-G
title: XC6206 series: 200 mA CMOS fixed-output positive LDO regulators, 1.2 V to 5.0 V
summary: Three-terminal CMOS linear regulators with a laser-trimmed fixed output, set at the factory anywhere from 1.2 V to 5.0 V in 0.1 V steps, running from inputs up to 6.0 V on about 1 µA of supply current. Each part holds a reference, an error amplifier, a P-channel pass device and a foldback current limiter that also covers a shorted output, and works with low-ESR ceramic capacitors. Offered in SOT-23, SOT-89, USP-6B and TO-92. XC6206P332MR-G is the 3.3 V, ±2% member in SOT-23, halogen and antimony free.

circuits.title: Typical application circuit
circuits.description: The regulator between a battery-type input and the load: a 1.0 µF ceramic capacitor from VIN to ground at the input, and a 1.0 µF ceramic capacitor from VOUT to ground at the output. VSS goes to the common ground. Pin numbers are the SOT-23 ones.

circuits.title: Test circuit ①
circuits.description: Bench setup for the output, load, dropout, line and short-circuit figures: a DC supply with a voltmeter across it feeds VIN, with CIN at the pin; the output carries CL and a second voltmeter, then an ammeter in series with an adjustable load resistor to ground.

circuits.title: Test circuit ②
circuits.description: Supply-current setup: a DC supply on VIN, VOUT left open, and an ammeter between VSS and ground reading the current the part draws.

equations.name: Output current bound from dissipation
equations.note: Applies alongside the 500 mA absolute maximum output current.

where.VOUT1: 98% of the output seen with a steady VOUT(T) + 1.0 V input at the given IOUT
where.VIN1: input voltage at which the output has fallen to VOUT1 as the input is brought down slowly

operation.text: A voltage reference feeds an error amplifier that compares it with the output through an internal resistor divider and drives a P-channel pass transistor between VIN and VOUT. A current-limit block sits in the drive path. The diodes at VIN and VOUT are ESD protection, and the one across the pass transistor is its parasitic body diode.

The output is fixed by laser trimming at any value from 1.2 V to 5.0 V in 0.1 V steps. The standard grade holds ±2% at 1.5 V and above and ±30 mV below 1.5 V; a ±1% grade exists for outputs of 2.0 V and above.

A foldback current limiter both caps the output current and protects against a shorted output: past the limit the output voltage and current fall back together, leaving the short-circuit current (E-6) below the limit point. For the 3.3 V type the maximum output current is 200 mA or more and the short-circuit current about 100 mA.
The series works with low-ESR ceramic capacitors. The typical application and test circuit ① use 1.0 µF ceramic at both input and output.

For the 3.3 V type, dropout is 75 mV typical (350 mV max) at 30 mA and 250 mV typical (680 mV max) at 100 mA. Types of 1.8 V and below are specified at 60 mA for the second dropout figure, and their load regulation at 1 mA to 50 mA.
Allowed dissipation at 25 °C is 250 mW in SOT-23, 500 mW in SOT-89, 100 mW in USP-6B and 300 mW in TO-92. The 500 mA output current rating carries the relation IOUT = Pd / (VIN - VOUT).
The exposed pad under the USP-6B package is soldered to the recommended land and stencil pattern for mechanical strength and heat removal. If it is connected to a pin, it must be pin 4 (VIN).

While the input is still below the level the output needs, the supply current rises well above its regulating value, to about 13 µA for the 3.0 V type and 18 µA for the 5.0 V type, then drops back to about 1 µA once the input passes the nominal output voltage.
